## Symptom
The 02:00Z digest run dies on its first query; a manual run later the same morning works (run:fixture-org/inkwell/6790233104).

## Root cause
The reset at 01:30Z gave the job's role a new login, and nothing pushed it to the job, which kept using credentials that were out of date (issue:fixture-org/inkwell#27). The database answered within 212 ms and rejected the login; it had been serving the web app since 01:58Z (raw:20261012T020004Z-7be2c905).

## Fix / workaround
Make the secret sync part of the reset (issue:fixture-org/inkwell#27).

## How it is caught
The rejected login is in the alert itself (raw:20261012T020004Z-7be2c905).
